name: Rufin
bio: Rufin and his trusty canary, Marigold, are what other Deepcast miners would call 'real grafters'. While others knock off at quitting time, Rufin keeps on digging. He and Marigold dug so deep, they were reported as M.W.M: missing while mining. It's a good thing too – only a miner as dedicated as Rufin can handle the horrors down deep.

effects.label: Shield
effects.description: Gives the recipient a HP Shield. All damage the recipient takes will be subtracted from the Shield first, before their HP.Each Skill can only cast one Shield at a time on each recipient.

effects.label: ATK Up
effects.description: Increases the recipient's Attack stat by the indicated percentage.

effects.label: Combo SPD Up
effects.description: Increases the recipient's Combo Speed stat by the indicated percentage.
